name: Legacy of Kain: Antologia
storyline:
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
As Raziel, stalk the shadows of Nosgoth preying upon your former vampire brethren in your quest to destroy your creator- Kain. After being betrayed and executed by Kain, return to Nosgoth on an epic mission of revenge. A milestone in 3D adventure.

Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
In this sequel to the critically acclaimed Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, reassume the role of Raziel, and travel back through the currents of time into various eras of Nosgoth's past in your relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the vampire genocide.

Blood Omen 2: Legacy of Kain
Cast down from power by a mysterious warlord centuries ago, Kain reawakens in a world he barely recognises. His armies slain, his vampire brethren nearly extinct, Kain is one of the last of his kind. With an agenda of vengeance, Kain shall unleash a wicked wrath to uncover the plot that threatens the land he seeks to conquer.

Legacy of Kain: Defiance
Take control of two powerful and highly evolved vampires: Kain, an all-powerful demigod, and Raziel, a demonic angel of death. Each equipped with a legendary sword, Kain & Raziel must battle through a world loaded with conflict and intrigue as they attempt to unravel their destinies and defeat the dark forces that seek to condemn their world to eternal damnation.
summary:
This compilation contains four games from the Legacy of Kain series. The included titles follow the vampires Kain and Raziel through the world of Nosgoth, where conflicts among vampires, humans, and other supernatural forces drive the series’ narrative.

The games combine action, exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving, with players controlling Kain, Raziel, or both characters depending on the title.

Includes:

- Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
- Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
- Blood Omen 2: Legacy of Kain
- Legacy of Kain: Defiance
